summary: Dental and dermatology under one roof, evening hours and WhatsApp booking are strengths, but dead buttons and typos appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: The booking button appears to read 'Schedule Appoinment', and several Book Now buttons on the dental, dermatology and doctor cards appear to link to #.
findings.cost: A patient who taps Book Now and reaches nothing may call another clinic.
findings.fix: Working booking buttons and a booking form.

findings.problem: The hero appears to say 'open until 9 pm every day' while the footer shows 'Fri : 2 – 9 pm', and the copyright appears as 2025.
findings.cost: Conflicting hours cause wasted trips and a poor first visit.
findings.fix: Accurate hours and a current footer.

findings.problem: The clinic appears as Al Kindi Clinics, Alkindi Clinics and Al-Kindi Clinic, and the Dermatology and doctor blocks appear twice with different staff lists.
findings.cost: Mixed names and repeated blocks confuse patients and search engines.
findings.fix: One brand name and one team list.

findings.problem: The page appears to promise 'prices that fit a normal budget' with no prices shown, four undated testimonials, and a free mail address alkindiclinics@gmail.com as contact.
findings.cost: No prices, thin proof and a free mail contact weaken a medical brand.
findings.fix: Clear price ranges, dated reviews and a branded email.

redesign: Accurate hours, one brand name, one team list.
Prices, dated reviews and branded email.
